The {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}s whose datasets will be used to train the
the {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline}s

title:
A type to store the batch outputs for a {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelCreationJob}. Note that
each batch stores 3 lists - one for the {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.Pipeline}s to train, one for the
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}s whose datasets will be used to train the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s,
and one for the names to be used for the newly trained {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s. The lists are of the same length,
and the i-th element of each list corresponds to the i-th combination of pipeline, dataset preparation run, and model name
to be trained.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelCreationJobBatch
